title: Battle of Kleisova
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kleisova", at revision 1370267217, opens: "The Battle of Kleisova was a military event of the Greek Revolution of 1821 that took place in 1825 on the islet of Kleisova in the Lagoon of Missolonghi." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16331889, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1825 battle in Greek War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
